title: Goose — one turn, end to end
example_input: list the files in src/ and summarize what this project does
note: Auto mode, default extensions. Pinned at v1.53.0.

steps.title: Input
steps.narrative: The user types 'list the files in src/ and summarize what this project does' in the CLI, Auto mode, default extensions. Agent::reply assigns a message ID; reply_impl finds no elicitation content; use_state_machine=false skips the new path; SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit hooks fire; execute_command returns Ok(None) — not a slash command; the message is persisted via session_manager.add_message.
steps.representation:
user text
  → Agent::reply()
  → reply_impl: hooks, slash-command check
  → session_manager.add_message()

steps.title: Prompt assembly
steps.narrative: reply_internal → prepare_reply_context → prepare_tools_and_prompt: tools are collected via list_tools from the extension manager, names enforced unique, and the system prompt is built with PromptManager from extension info plus directory hints plus the goose mode. Toolshim vs native tools are split per model_config.toolshim. A moim turn-context message (time, working dir, compaction status, turn budget) is persisted as an agent-only user message before the loop.
steps.representation:
reply_internal
  → prepare_reply_context
  → prepare_tools_and_prompt: list_tools + PromptManager
  → moim turn-context message persisted

steps.title: Model call
steps.narrative: Loop iteration 1: turns_taken → 1. stream_response_from_provider → provider.stream(&model_config, system_prompt, messages, &tools) — streaming, with pre-first-item transient retries (≤3, exponential backoff 1s→30s; mid-stream errors are not retried). Text chunks yield AgentEvent::Message live.
steps.representation:
turns_taken → 1
  → stream_response_from_provider()
  → provider.stream(model_config, system_prompt, messages, tools)
  → AgentEvent::Message (live)

steps.title: Response parse
steps.narrative: categorize_tool_requests extracts the model's ToolRequests, canonicalizes model-mangled names (recover_mangled_tool_name), coerces arguments to the advertised JSON schema, and dedupes tool-call IDs. Calls to unadvertised tools become invalid_request errors — invalid tool calls are data, not exceptions.
steps.representation:
categorize_tool_requests(response)
  → recover_mangled_tool_name
  → coerce args to advertised JSON schema
  → invalid_request for unadvertised tools

steps.title: Tool dispatch
steps.narrative: inspect_tools splits requests into approved / needs_approval / denied. A read-only call lands in approved → dispatch_tool_call → PreToolUse hooks fire → extension_manager.dispatch_tool_call runs it → with_post_tool_hook wraps it (large-response spill + PostToolUse hooks). A mutating call would instead hit handle_approval_tool_requests: a oneshot registered in the ToolConfirmationRouter, an ActionRequired event yielded, the loop genuinely paused until submit_tool_confirmation delivers the verdict.
steps.representation:
inspect_tools → approved / needs_approval / denied
  → PreToolUse hooks → dispatch_tool_call
  → mutating: ActionRequired, loop awaits verdict

steps.title: Result feedback
steps.narrative: Tool outputs attach as ToolResponse blocks on user-role messages; request/response pairs go into messages_to_add, persisted per message and appended to the conversation. Thinking blocks ride on the first tool-call carrier message; unparseable calls become a well-formed "unparseable_tool_call" placeholder. Large text outputs spill to an owner-only temp file (200,000-char default) before feedback.
steps.representation:
ToolResponse blocks on user messages
  → messages_to_add → persisted per message
  → large outputs spill to temp file (200k chars)

steps.title: Loop or exit
steps.narrative: Iteration 2: the model answers in text with no further tool calls → exit_chat = true; the stop hook allows → break. Otherwise the loop continues until turns_taken > 1000 (DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS), cancellation, an error arm, or the stop-hook denial cap of 8. There is no max_iterations symbol anywhere — the bound is max_turns, full stop.
steps.representation:
no tool calls → exit_chat = true → break
  else → next iteration
  turns_taken > 1000 → MAX_TURNS_MESSAGE, break

steps.title: Rendering
steps.narrative: Nothing is printed by the loop itself — all output is AgentEvents (streamed text, ActionRequired prompts, Usage updates) consumed by the CLI, the desktop, and the ACP frontends. Final summary text accumulates in last_assistant_text.
steps.representation:
AgentEvent stream → CLI / desktop / ACP
  → last_assistant_text accumulates
